claim_detail: ESF publishes the Michael M. Szwarc Polymer Research Institute (PRI) at esf.edu/polymer, administered by the Department of Chemistry in Jahn Laboratory; ESF's campus tour page also lists the PRI as a current program unit of Jahn Laboratory

PRI's published mission: a consortium of associate members established to advance polymer science through education and research and to develop strong cooperative programs with polymer-based industries nationwide; membership presently includes SUNY ESF, SUNY-Albany and Syracuse University faculty plus industry members

The Polymer Engineering Center (PEC) exists at UW-Madison's College of Engineering; its site gives its location as the Mechanical Engineering Building, 1513 University Avenue, Madison, WI 53706, with center contact email and phone.

PEC was created in 2001 by eleven College of Engineering faculty 'to address these problems collectively with the plastics industry through education, training, and research' and joined an NSF Industry/University Cooperative Research Center sponsored by industrial consortia and NSF — a polymer/plastics research center serving industry collaboration.
